rdfs:label: Travel
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor is travelling between two locations — the origin is the `origin`, the destination is the `target`.
notes: IntransitiveActivity: the actor is the one travelling, so there is no `object`. Use `origin` for the starting point and `target` for the destination; either may be omitted. Distinct from `Move` (the actor moves an *object* from origin to target) and `Arrive` (the actor has arrived at a `location`, with no origin implied).

examples.title: Actor travelling from London to Paris

history.note: Notes no longer claim Travel is only for in-progress trips; clarified origin/target and Move/Arrive distinctions.
